Frequently Asked Questions

What is the revenue of Interglobe Aviation Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month revenue of Interglobe Aviation Ltd. is ₹ 89,049.70 Cr, reflecting a 1-year growth of 8.96% and a 3-year CAGR of 15.18%. Annual and quarterly revenue trends are available in the Income Statement section.
What is the net profit of Interglobe Aviation Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month net profit (PAT) of Interglobe Aviation Ltd. is ₹ -4,805.80 Cr, with a 3-year earnings CAGR of -48.10%. Detailed profit history across annual and quarterly periods is in the Income Statement section.
What is the EBITDA of Interglobe Aviation Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month EBITDA of Interglobe Aviation Ltd. is approximately ₹ 7,722.50 Cr (based on an operating margin of 8.67%). EBITDA reflects core operating profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation.
What is the EPS of Interglobe Aviation Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month Earnings Per Share (EPS) of Interglobe Aviation Ltd. is -124.36. EPS trends across annual and quarterly periods are visible in the Income Statement section.
What is the debt level of Interglobe Aviation Ltd.?
The debt-to-equity ratio of Interglobe Aviation Ltd. stands at 11.15. The interest coverage ratio is 1.27x, reflecting the company's ability to service debt from operating earnings. The full breakdown of total borrowings is in the Balance Sheet section.
What is the book value per share of Interglobe Aviation Ltd.?
The estimated book value per share of Interglobe Aviation Ltd. is 180.29 (derived from a P/B ratio of 25.93 and market price of ₹ 4,675.00), reflecting the net asset value attributable to each share. See the Balance Sheet section for a full breakdown.
What is the cash flow from operations of Interglobe Aviation Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month operating cash flow of Interglobe Aviation Ltd. is ₹ 20,085.20 Cr. Annual and quarterly cash flow data is available in the Cash Flow section of the Statements tab.
Does Interglobe Aviation Ltd. report consolidated or standalone financials?
Interglobe Aviation Ltd. reports consolidated financials. You can toggle between consolidated and standalone views using the switch at the top of each statement section.
